figurative_meaning_bn: অসহিষ্ণু, রগচটা, নিয়ত খেঁকখেঁক করে এমন
figurative_meaning_en: impatient, short-tempered, constantly grumbling or whining
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে খুব খেঁকি প্রকৃতির, সামান্য কথায় রেগে যায়।
অফিসে খেঁকি করতে করতে সবার মাথা ধরিয়ে দিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: She has a very khenki nature, getting angry over small things.
He's been khenki all day at the office, annoying everyone with his constant grumbling.
note: Often used to describe women in traditional contexts, as in 'খেঁকি মহিলা'
